prompt: Write 10 distinct short extracts of Larkmere Mutual's official guidance, procedures or policy wording about: porting a mortgage to a new property. Two to four sentences each, in the society's own formal voice. Use type "fact". Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 0)
